qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise territory and rate-base regulation with monopolistic transmission and distribution grid across Arizona.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). Pinnacle West benefits from strong Phoenix population and industrial load growth (semiconductor manufacturing), but operates under a high-leverage regulated capital structure (LT debt/NI of 14.6x) and weak interest coverage of 2.53x (below 5.0x threshold). Massive grid capex ($2.6B vs $632M NI) forces continuous debt issuance and reliance on external capital markets.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year GAAP ROIC median of 5.56% (2025: 5.88%, 2024: 6.03%, 2022: 4.79%, 2019: 5.28%). Long-term debt of $9.21B against net income of $631.6M results in 14.6x leverage (far above 4.0x ceiling). EBIT of $1.07B covers interest of $422M at only 2.53x (hurdle >5.0x). Capex of $2.62B exceeds operating cash flow of $1.81B, requiring ongoing debt capital market access to fund rate base expansion.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
